title: Electric potential at A
description: Essential: Correctly calculates φ_A = -W_∞A / q, yielding 100 V.

title: Potential difference A to B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates U_AB = φ_A - φ_B, yielding -300 V.

title: Work for negative charge
description: Essential: Correctly calculates W_AB = q' * U_AB for the new charge, yielding 6e-3 J.

title: Relates work to potential
description: Important: Applies the relationship W_ext = qΔV or W_field = -qΔV correctly for each given work value.

title: Handles sign of charge
description: Important: Correctly accounts for the sign of the charge when calculating work for part (3).

title: Potential at infinity zero
description: Important: Uses the condition that potential at infinity is zero to find φ_A and φ_B.

title: Sign error in potential difference
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly calculates U_AB as φ_B - φ_A or misinterprets the sign from the work equations.

title: Work sign confusion
description: Pitfall: Confuses work done by the field with work done by an external force, leading to sign errors.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (V, J, C) throughout the calculation.
